com.secugen.secusearch.api

Enum SSConfLevel

  • java.lang.Object
    • java.lang.Enum<SSConfLevel>
      • com.secugen.secusearch.api.SSConfLevel
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    Serializable, Comparable<SSConfLevel>

    public enum SSConfLevel
extends Enum<SSConfLevel>
    An enumeration class for the confidence level of a search candidate.

    It quantifies the degree of similarity between the query and candidate fingerprints.

    If the confidence level is above NORMAL, it is regarded mostly that the two fingerprints match.

    Level values:

    • LOWEST = 1
    • LOWER = 2
    • LOW = 3
    • BELOW_NORMAL = 4
    • NORMAL = 5
    • ABOVE_NORMAL = 6
    • HIGH = 7
    • HIGHER = 8
    • HIGHEST = 9

    • Field Detail

      • levelComparator

        public static Comparator<SSConfLevel> levelComparator
        A instance implementing a Comparator interface for SSConfLevel.

        Its compare(SSConfLevel, SSConfLevel) function compares the levels of its two arguments. Then it returns a negative integer, zero, or a positive integer as the level of the first argument is less than, equal to, or greater than the level of the second.

        For example. levelComparator.compare(HIGH, HIGHER) returns a negative integer.
